hypothesis: H4 controlled follow-up: removing auxiliary image-category and text-category objectives reduces validation relation-classification performance under the fixed setup.

seed_44_shared_initialization.portable_verification: The saved initial state is verified by tensor keys, shapes, and SHA-256. Fresh random initialization is not compared byte-for-byte across operating systems.

controlled_variables: Dataset V3 train and validation relations
TF-IDF unigram and bigram text representation
Adam optimizer, learning rate 0.001, weight decay 0.0001
batch size 32, image augmentation, maximum 80 epochs, patience 10
changed_variable: The image-category head, text-category head, and their two weighted losses were removed.
interpretation: All relation-only runs collapsed to one predicted class. Under this fixed architecture and protocol, auxiliary category supervision is a material component of the successful selected model. The result does not establish that every multimodal architecture requires auxiliary supervision.
note: The canonical result records the classes produced by this verified rerun: seed 43 -> MATCH; seeds 44 and 45 -> MISMATCH.
